parents.subject: Agricultural Leadership, Education, and Communications Program

ns2:course.label: Introduction to Agricultural Leadership, Education and Communications
ns2:course.description: Provides an introduction to basic leadership, communications, and educational theory. Covers the practical application of theories in professional, educational, and community contexts. Designed as the foundational course underlying the ALEC undergraduate curriculum. No credit given if already completed AGCM 110 or AGED 100.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: No credit given if already completed AGCM 110 or AGED 100.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Agricultural Education or Org & Community Leadership or Ag Communications-Advertising or Ag Communications-Journalism concentration(s).
